description: Save decks, total collection inventory, priority order and constraints to the connected account. Ask the player to choose a name. Create a new plan without id/revision; update only with the current id and revision from list_collection_plans. Does not save recommendation results or shopping prices. Never publish private plan inputs. Do not overwrite without a user request.

budgetUsd.description: Shared purchase budget for the entire plan, USD. Decks receive priority in input order.

deck.description: Quantity-prefixed main-deck text including the commander. Import public deck URLs with import_deck first, then pass the returned text.

owned.description: Total collection inventory, including copies used by all submitted decks. Up to 150 quantity-prefixed entries and 100 copies per canonical card.

qaTest.description: Internal QA only: set true when the user explicitly says this is our test run. Excludes the call from usage/revenue statistics. Omit for normal player requests.

name: save_collection_plan
title: Save a private collection plan to my account
